text:
Layered application-delivery architecture

This is a platform-neutral reference architecture rather than a verified description of this workspace. Delivery flows from source through build and deployment into runtime; user traffic flows through the edge to applications and data services, with security and observability spanning the platform.

Diagram
flowchart TB
  subgraph Experience[Experience layer]
    Users[Users and developers]
    Clients[Web mobile and API clients]
  end

  subgraph Edge[Access and edge layer]
    DNS[DNS and traffic management]
    Gateway[CDN load balancer and API gateway]
    Identity[Identity and access management]
  end

  subgraph Delivery[Application delivery layer]
    Source[Source control]
    Pipeline[CI and CD pipeline]
    Registry[Artifact and image registry]
    Deploy[Deployment controller]
  end

  subgraph Runtime[Application runtime layer]
    Compute[Containers functions or virtual machines]
    Services[Application services and workers]
    Mesh[Service discovery and messaging]
  end

  subgraph Data[Data and integration layer]
    Cache[Cache]
    Database[Databases]
    Storage[Object and file storage]
    External[External systems and APIs]
  end

  subgraph Foundation[Infrastructure layer]
    Network[Networks and connectivity]
    Platform[Compute orchestration and operating platform]
    Secrets[Secrets keys and configuration]
  end

  Observe[Observability logging metrics and tracing]
  Policy[Security policy governance and compliance]

  Users --> Clients
  Clients --> DNS --> Gateway
  Identity --> Gateway
  Gateway --> Services

  Users --> Source
  Source --> Pipeline --> Registry --> Deploy
  Deploy --> Compute
  Deploy --> Secrets

  Compute --> Services
  Services <--> Mesh
  Services --> Cache
  Services --> Database
  Services --> Storage
  Services --> External

  Network --> Gateway
  Network --> Platform
  Platform --> Compute
  Secrets --> Services

  Gateway --> Observe
  Pipeline --> Observe
  Compute --> Observe
  Services --> Observe
  Policy --> Identity
  Policy --> Pipeline
  Policy --> Deploy
  Policy --> Platform
limitations: The supplied information does not identify the platform or its workspace architecture, so component names and availability cannot be verified.
